title: Take a change from a new worktree to main

steps.title: See every worktree at once
steps.body: One row per worktree: docs is a commit ahead of main, and experiment has uncommitted changes (!). @ marks where you are.

steps.title: Start a worktree for a new change
steps.body: --create makes the branch and its worktree together and moves your shell into it: one command in place of git worktree add plus a cd.

steps.title: Make the change
steps.body: Edit a file as you or an agent would. The other worktrees don't see it.

steps.title: See the change in the list
steps.body: raise-price now shows ! for uncommitted changes and +1 -1 for the lines changed.

steps.title: Merge it into main
steps.body: No git commit needed: wt merge commits the change, rebases onto main if needed, fast-forwards main, removes the worktree and branch, and brings your shell back to main.

steps.title: Jump to another worktree
steps.body: wt switch with no branch opens a picker: type to filter, move with the arrow keys, Enter to switch, Esc to leave.
